name: Bevest ASA
summary: BEVEST ASA operates as an investment firm, primarily investing in companies within industrial production, seafood, and property sectors. The company provides products and services through its portfolio companies, including machinery, mechanical services, automation, robotics, welding, surface treatment, assembly, and series production in industrial production. It develops and supplies universal protectors for tubulars in the oil and gas sector, energy-efficient insulation solutions for buildings, and circular packaging solutions such as expanded polystyrene products.
